description: This file defines data structures and function prototypes for managing HTTP headers dynamically within the cURL project. It includes structures for header entries and collections, along with functions to initialize, manipulate, and retrieve headers.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_init
methods.description: Initialize the dynhds structure with specified maximum entries and string size limits.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_free
methods.description: Free all internal data of the dynhds structure without freeing the structure itself.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_reset
methods.description: Reset the dynhds to its initial state, keeping allocations intact.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_count
methods.description: Return the number of header entries currently stored.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_set_opts
methods.description: Set parsing options for header handling, replacing existing options.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_getn
methods.description: Retrieve the header entry at the specified index.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_get
methods.description: Retrieve the first header entry matching the given name.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_cget
methods.description: Retrieve the first header entry with a case-insensitive match for the given name.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_contains
methods.description: Check if any header entries with the specified name exist.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_ccontains
methods.description: Case-insensitive check if headers with specified name exist.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_count_name
methods.description: Count the number of headers with the given name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_ccount_name
methods.description: Count the number of headers with the given null-terminated name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_add
methods.description: Add a header entry with name and value to the collection.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_cadd
methods.description: Add a header with null-terminated name and value strings.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_remove
methods.description: Remove all entries with the specified name, case-sensitive.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_cremove
methods.description: Remove all entries with the specified case-insensitive name.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_set
methods.description: Replace all headers with the given name and set a new value.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_cset
methods.description: Set header with given null-terminated name and value, replacing existing entries.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_h1_cadd_line
methods.description: Add a header line in HTTP/1.1 format from a string line.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_h1_add_line
methods.description: Add a header line with explicit line length.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_h1_dprint
methods.description: Print all headers in HTTP/1.1 format into a dynamic buffer.

methods.name: Curl_dynhds_to_nva
methods.description: Convert headers to nghttp2 name-value array format (if NGHTTP2 is used).

ctags.name: hds_allc
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t hds_allc;  \/* size of hds allocation *\/$/

ctags.name: hds_len
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t hds_len;   \/* number of entries in hds *\/$/

ctags.name: max_entries
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t max_entries;   \/* size limit number of entries *\/$/

ctags.name: max_strs_size
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t max_strs_size; \/* max length of all strings *\/$/

ctags.name: strs_len
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t strs_len; \/* length of all strings *\/$/
